thesis: The morning pullback thesis is intact. At an intraday last of 51.875 (inside the 50.7-52.0 zone), GMAB holds above SMA20 50.664, SMA50 41.5188 and SMA200 31.6363 (rs_63 +0.65, RSI 60), and today's low of 51.78 stayed above the 50.68 swing low on light volume (vol_ratio 0.76), in a healthcare sector that leads the risk-off tape. Against the 49.6 stop, the 59.5 target gives about 3.4 R/R from the last price (about 2.4 to the 57.06 resistance). The fade from the 52.66 open, the unexplained Oct 28 spike, insider selling and a stop only about 1.0 ATR away keep this a low-confidence, pullback-only position.
invalidation: A daily close below 49.6 (under the 50.68 10-day swing low), or a close below the 20-day SMA (about 50.7) on rising volume, voids the setup and opens a retrace toward the 44.67-45.44 gap zone.
